scope: Development navigation judgments, grouped by natural language, controls and unsupported questions. Five added cases derive from existing source contracts before experiment outcomes; no independent human or held-out accuracy claim.

config_env_overrides.criterion: Must find the config classmethod that reads prefixed environment variables into the runtime config; CLI flag handling and the doctor report's environment listing are irrelevant.

ingest_ignore_policy.criterion: Must find the source-selection policy that loads ignore files and decides per path whether it is skipped; size-based exclusions and parser selection are irrelevant.

embed_worker_retry_backoff.criterion: Must find the background embedding worker loop with capped exponential backoff after failures and the batched drain pass; inline embed-on-search and vector math are irrelevant.

request_body_size_limit.criterion: Must find the ASGI wrapper that caps accumulated HTTP body chunks with a 413 before parsing; post-parse validation and response budgets are irrelevant.

backup_export_publish.criterion: Must find the export publication that stages, verifies, fsyncs and renames, plus the guard rejecting database or sidecar destinations; restore and recovery snapshots are irrelevant.

schema_identifier_rules.criterion: Must find the check enforcing the naming pattern and rejecting reserved Cypher keywords for interpolated names; schema DDL and schema description rendering are irrelevant.

server_stop_graceful.criterion: Must find the admin logic that stops a registered daemon: pidfile validation, stale cleanup, graceful endpoint, then signal fallback; the server-side shutdown handler is irrelevant.

init_client_detection.criterion: Must find the function that checks config directories for Claude, Cursor, Windsurf and Zed with a Claude fallback; per-editor config writes are irrelevant.

source_scope_fingerprint.criterion: Must find the function that hashes each parseable file and folds version, parser revision, options and size exclusions into the tree digest; the refresher and ingest verification are irrelevant.

search_label_cap.criterion: Must find the post-fusion step limiting how many seeds one label may occupy, with backfill; config declaration, RRF and FTS retrieval are irrelevant.

cross_label_bm25.criterion: Must find the reranker that recomputes BM25 over a multi-label candidate pool with shared statistics, plus its word splitter; native FTS querying and RRF are irrelevant.

multi_db_name_resolution.criterion: Must find the registry method mapping a short database name to a file in the database directory, rejecting traversal; header routing and service caching are irrelevant.

queries.query: How do I change settings like the database location or the default answer token budget using environment variables rather than command-line flags?
environment variable overrides runtime configuration prefix settings
What happens to files matched by my project's ignore patterns, or sitting inside dependency folders and virtual environments, when I index a repository?
skip ignored files git ignore patterns generated directories symlink nested repository indexing policy
If computing vectors in the background keeps failing, does the worker give up, or does it retry and wait longer between attempts?
background embedding worker failure retry exponential backoff pending vectors batches
I want to make sure a client can't send a huge upload to the HTTP server; where are incoming bodies capped before they get parsed, even when they arrive in chunks?
HTTP request body size limit 413 chunked payload too large
When exporting a backup to a file, how does it avoid leaving a half-written file behind or accidentally overwriting the live database and its log files?
backup export staged temporary file verify rename refuse overwrite database sidecar
Why would defining a table or property called order or group be rejected, and what naming rules apply to labels in the schema?
schema name rules reserved Cypher keywords allowed characters table property names
What happens when I shut down the background daemon for my project: does it first ask for a clean exit, and when would it resort to signalling or killing the process instead?
stop server daemon graceful shutdown pidfile terminate signal fallback force verified
During project setup, how does the tool figure out which AI coding editors I use so it knows whose config files to write?
project init editor config directories Claude Cursor Windsurf Zed fallback MCP registration
What ends up in the digest that identifies one state of my indexed code: just each file's contents, or also the tool version, parser revision, saved options and files skipped for size?
code index fingerprint file content hashes parser revision version options size exclusions digest
How does search keep one large category of results, like code functions, from taking every top slot?
per label diversity cap top results crowding hold pool backfill fused ranking
I want keyword relevance scores to be comparable when matches come from several different node types; where are hits rescored with shared term statistics, and how is the text split into words?
BM25 rerank shared document frequency candidate pool tokenization casefold stemming across labels
When one server hosts a folder of several databases, how is a short database name turned into an actual file, and what stops someone from escaping the folder with a path?
multi database directory name lookup case insensitive default database path traversal rejection

source_policy: Fresh independent graphs per scope, canonical fixture://grag/ provenance, deterministic repo identity and fixed ingestion timestamps; all variants ingest the same git archive. No gold or audit files are indexed.
